def lc():
    r = last_action_result
    return r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('run_complete')
def swap_state():
    # blue solid (16 px) position: top (20,18) or bottom (34,8)
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b)
            return 'B' if r0==20 else 'C'
    return '?'
print('now', swap_state())
tests = [(21,19,'checker top center'),(35,9,'blue solid bottom center'),(31,20,'dark red'),(31,10,'gray mat mid'),(19,23,'gray mat top'),(20,18,'top slot corner')]
for r,c,lab in tests:
    s0 = swap_state()
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print(lab, swap_state(), '(was', s0, ') lc', lc())
    if lc(): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
